messages:
alex: Quick sync — dropping a proposal in docs soon: we want a 'grand sweep' to split three big surfaces (ingress, session, model-store) into explicit modules. Main goals: reduce cross-team churn, enable per-service scaling, and make rollback easier. Thoughts?

mira: +1. Do we have ownership mapping? need clear owners per module before cut.

sam: curious about runtime hotpath impact. we can't add a 2-hop proxy for every request without measuring.

nina: agree. tradeoff: duplication vs runtime latency. Could we do a compatibility shim that routes within same process until cutover?

pranav: propose phases: 1) define minimal RPC contracts, 2) implement shims, 3) strip deprecated APIs, 4) cutover per region.

alex: here's a sketch of the RPC contract (very small): ```proto
service SessionStore {
  rpc Get(SessionReq) returns (Session) {}
  rpc Put(Session) returns (Ack) {}
}
``` keep it minimal — no batching semantics in the contract.

mira: testing plan: unit + integration + duet load test (staged: 10k -> 100k -> 1M qps). also add golden prompt evals to check quality/regression post-split.

sam: perf question: can we preserve KV-cache locality? if shard boundaries change, cache pressure could spike.

nina: mitigation: prefix pinning + warmup tasks during cutover. also staged tenant cohorts and cache pre-warm.

pranav: rollout control: feature-flagged routing by tenant + canary 3% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. fallback to monolith path on errors.

alex: who volunteers to own the "compat shim" POC? need a small spike (2w) with perf regression <5% and latency SLO preserved.

mira: i'll take POC with nina.

sam: i'll map out runtime kernels and quantify added hop cost (bench + flamegraphs).

nina: also add observability: token-level histograms, cross-service traces, and synthetic workloads for prompt coverage.

alex: ok, next steps: write RFC doc, assign owners, schedule 2-week spike. i'll drop a PR to /docs in next 24h. tagging @deploy-bot for a heads up.

deploy-bot: Note: created RFC branch 'grand-sweep-mod' and set reviewers mira,sam.

mira: tiny nit — let's include a rollback checklist (db-migration-free, config toggle, traffic-shift script).

pranav: added: post-cutover runtime suicide guard if error rate >5% for 3m and automated rollback trigger.

alex: Thanks. I'll draft RFC and ping PMs. :thumbsup:
